sources.author: Maya Chen · Customer Success
sources.title: Confirmed onboarding date
sources.body: We confirm that Atlas investor onboarding will go live by 17:00 UTC on 16 October. I am the delivery owner. This commitment assumes the signed mapping arrives by 14 October.

sources.author: Leo Park · Engineering
sources.title: ATL-142: Mapping dependency
sources.body: ATL-142 is blocked. The signed investor-field mapping has not arrived. Engineering cannot finalize the import until it is received.

sources.author: Maya Chen · Customer Success
sources.title: #atlas-launch
sources.body: The signed mapping is still missing at 16:00 UTC on 14 October. I will request a revised launch date from the client; no new date is approved yet.

sources.author: Nora Diaz · Atlas client
sources.title: Signed mapping attached
sources.body: We delivered the signed mapping at 08:45 UTC today, 15 October. We still expect the Friday launch unless you confirm otherwise.

sources.author: Leo Park · Engineering
sources.title: ATL-142: Import built; QA pending
sources.body: The mapping was received at 08:45 UTC on 15 October. Import implementation is complete. End-to-end QA and client acceptance are still pending.

sources.author: Maya Chen · Customer Success
sources.title: #atlas-launch: Unapproved revised date
sources.body: Engineering proposes 19 October for launch. This is a proposal only; the client has not approved it. Do not treat it as a replacement commitment.

sources.author: Nora Diaz · Atlas client
sources.title: Escalation: onboarding unavailable
sources.body: It is now 18:00 UTC on 16 October and investor onboarding is unavailable. You confirmed 17:00 UTC today. Please explain what happened and who owns the recovery.
